From: mail01@ravenscar.example
Sent: 2026-10-12 14:20:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Subject: RE: VSL-13 PARADIP - ANY DELAY AT ANCHORAGE

Dear Colleagues,

Charterer says no objection to diving while the vessel waits for a berth, as long as it does not delay berthing or cause off-hire claims; asks to be told the diving time.

- Charterer objection: no, if it does not delay berthing

Best regards,
Ravenscar Commodities

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@mahanadiagency.example
Sent: 2026-10-12 10:10:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Subject: RE: VSL-13 PARADIP - UNDERWATER INSPECTION AND CLEANING AT ANCHORAGE

Dear Colleagues,

Agent: UWI and UWC are allowed at the anchorage with port permission, 5 working days' notice, daylight, not during cargo operations; the berth wait is currently about 3 days; quote USD 7,400 for inspection and cleaning, USD 2,600 for inspection only.

- Uwc allowed: yes, anchorage
- Uwi allowed: yes, anchorage
- Permit lead working: 5 days
- Berth wait: 3 days
- Uwc quote: 7400 USD
- Uwi quote: 2600 USD

Best regards,
Mahanadi Shipping Agency

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Sent: 2026-10-11 16:40:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@mahanadiagency.example
Cc: mail01@paradeepdivers.example
Subject: VSL-13 PARADIP - UNDERWATER INSPECTION AND CLEANING AT ANCHORAGE

Dear Sirs,

Operator asks the Paradip agent and the diving contractor for a permit and quote for an inspection and cleaning at anchorage while the vessel waits for a berth.

Best regards,
Meridian Fleet Management

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Sent: 2026-10-11 13:00:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@vsl13.example
Subject: VSL-13 SPEED LOSS - POSSIBLE HULL FOULING

Dear Captain,

Operator asks the master to confirm the speed loss: 10.4 kn at the same rpm and weather where 11.4 kn was normal; suspects fouling after the long stay at Mundra.

Best regards,
Meridian Fleet Management
